We need to answer based on policy excerpts. The question: "There's a large overage charge on our invoice but our usage never came close to the threshold — can this be investigated and reversed?" This is about disputing a usage overage charge. According to policy: customers can ask billing team to review underlying metered data. The policy says it's handled case by case by a human reviewer, and the account owner or billing contact is the one who can raise it. So we should respond that they can request a review, but it must be raised by account owner/billing contact, and a human will investigate. We can give guidance: they should contact billing team, provide details, etc. The policy says it's handled case by case by a human reviewer rather than resolved from a general article. So we can respond that they need to raise a dispute with billing team; we can’t reverse automatically. Provide steps.

We must keep answer short and specific, address customer directly. Use policy content. So answer: Yes, you can request a review; please have the account owner/billing contact raise a dispute; our billing team will investigate the raw usage record and determine if reversal is appropriate.

Thus we can post_reply.

arguments.message:
Hi there,

You can definitely have our billing team review that overage charge. A member of your account (the account owner or billing contact) will need to raise a dispute so we can compare the raw usage records against the charge. Our reviewers will investigate any metering bugs, mis‑configurations, or other issues and determine whether a reversal is appropriate. Please have the appropriate contact submit the request, and we’ll take it from there.

Thanks,
Meridian Support
